definition: a brass instrument you blow into
description: Close on a row of bandsmen in dark uniforms and white plumed helmets, each holding a golden brass instrument to his lips and blowing, fingers on the valves and the wide bells pointing forward. They play while walking in step down a street. The camera pulls back to show dozens more players in the same uniform filling the road, and behind the barriers a packed crowd waves Indian flags. The last shot looks down a long flag-lined avenue where the whole band stretches away in ranks.

de.answer: Sie marschieren eine lange Allee entlang.
de.question: Was machen die Musiker?

es.answer: Están desfilando por una larga avenida.
es.question: ¿Qué están haciendo los músicos de la banda?

fr.answer: Ils défilent sur une longue avenue.
fr.question: Que font les musiciens ?
